map.成绩（统计/公布/证书）系统是做什么的？: What does Athletics Performance Records System do?
map.如何使用成绩（统计/公布/证书）系统？: How do I use Athletics Performance Records System?
map.成绩（统计/公布/证书）系统适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Athletics Performance Records System best for?
map.逐行录入姓名与成绩，统计平均分、中位数、及格率与等级分布并自动排名: Statistical system for competition results, certificates and records.
map.平均分 = Σ成绩 ÷ 人数；得分率 = 成绩 ÷ 满分 × 100%；及格率: Average = Σ scores ÷ count; score rate = score ÷ full marks × 100%; pass rate = number passing ÷ count × 100%
map.取排序后中间值；得分率 = 成绩 ÷ 满分 × 100%；及格率 = 达标人数: = the middle value after sorting; score rate = score ÷ full marks × 100%; pass rate = number passing ÷ count × 100%.
map.中位数不受极端高分或低分影响，与平均分并列可判断成绩是否两极分化。: The median is unaffected by extreme high or low scores; placed beside the average it reveals whether results are polarized.
map.等级线可以改吗？: Can the grade thresholds be changed?
map.等级按得分率固定划分（优秀≥90%、良好80%–89%、及格60%–79%）；达: Grades are divided by fixed score-rate bands (excellent ≥90%, good 80%-89%, pass 60%-79%); the pass mark is customizable and is used to tally the pass rate and the pass list.
map.成绩（统计/公布/证书）系统。免费在线工具，纯前端处理，数据不上传，保护隐私安全: Athletics Performance Records System. A free online tool that runs entirely in the browser, uploads no data, and protects your privacy.
